index.html is the one file that decides which bundle a browser loads. It was being served
from the edge cache with an Age of several hours, so a deploy could land and the people using
the system would keep opening the previous build — the work was on the server and invisible,
which is indistinguishable from the work never having been deployed.
So the page revalidates on every request. The assets go the other way: Vite puts a content
hash in every filename, so a given URL's contents can never change and caching it for a year
